title: How Starting Fire Evolved 🔥 From Friction to a Click #shorts #engineering
description:
For most of history, making fire took real skill. From friction sticks and flint sparks (Ötzi the Iceman carried a fire kit 5,300 years ago) to John Walker's 1826 match, safety matches, pocket lighters, and today's click-to-light stoves and flameless induction. Follow for more How It Evolved!
